column2: I'm going to the Hill of Beginnings to rescue {s}!
You mustn't!
Why not!?
The Demon King wants to get his hands on you before the eclipse.
We expect the rioters to launch an all-out attack to capture you, {p}-kun!
We can't let you fall into the Demon King's hands! Stay here!
But...
The grief of losing Maria... I don't want you to taste that. I'll go to the Hill of Beginnings! To take {s} back!
Good! Will you go, Shinichi-kun?
Shinichi-san... Please, {s}...!
Leave it to me!
I'll stay here... and protect {p}-kun! If it weren't for {p}-kun, I might have destroyed the world by now!
Shusha-kun...
I nearly destroyed the world, so I want to protect it. Which means protecting you.
{p}-kun! We go way back, so I'm staying too! To protect you, that is. And I won't take no for an answer!
Honey, thank you...!
It seems the roles are settled.\n\nShinichi-kun, join the assault team headed for the Hill of Beginnings! Shusha-kun, stay here and lead the defense team! And Honey-kun, don't leave {p}-kun's side!
Leave it to me. I'll snatch {s} back!
Nobody's getting near {p}!
I'm sticking to {p}-kun like glue!
Professor Yumi! Something big is happening at the Hill of Beginnings! The rioters keep pouring in, and it's practically a castle now!
I took pictures of the enemy. Take a look at these.
The Hill of Beginnings seems to mean something special to the Demon King. Before we knew it, there were this many black fiends...
What numbers... How big are they?
Every last one of 'em is huge. They'd give Mazinger Z a run for its money.
Hmmm...
And then there's this!
The TV news said it was an altar before...!
That's how much the Demon King's power has grown.
A fearsome foe, this Demon King...!!
If the black fiends are as big as Mazinger or the Mechanical Beasts, then Koji-kun! You're the vanguard!\n\nDraw the black fiends' attention and protect the assault team!
Got it! Sayaka! Boss! Let's go!
Papa! I'm off!
I'm counting on you!
Father... I mean, Professor Yumi! I'll protect Sayaka!
Y-yes, well. Do your best, Boss.
Boss! Wait for meee!
Ooh! I'm rarin' to go!
I'll join the assault team along with Hell Villa! But Great King-sama, you stay here. We might need to swap out party members!
That's a splendid idea, Enma-kun! Great King Enma! I ask this of you as well!
Enma-kun, represent the Hell World well!
Leave it to me!
Hey, Enma-kun, don't leave me behind!
Aw, c'mon, pal! That's downright cruel!
{p}, come speak to me whenever you need me, my boy! I shall be waiting near the exit of the residential area!
Good! That concludes our strategy meeting! Everyone! Good luck!
Mind if I pick the defense team members? I'm thinking anyone not picked joins the assault team.
Got it. Let me know when you've finished picking the defense team!
Defense team or assault team? Assault team, obviously...!
I'll protect {p} with Honey.
Attacking's more my style, but...
As long as I'm with Mondo, either one's fine.
...Do as you like.
Attacking sounds like a blast, but defending sounds like a thrill too...
I'll follow the Boss, of course!
{p}-kun saved me. Now it's my turn to save him.
I'll never forget how you saved Miyuki-san. It's up to {p}. Either one's fine with me.
My duty is to protect Doji. I will follow Doji.
Fighting is my fate. Attack or defend!
As long as I'm with Jiro-kun, either one's fine!
I'm worried about Honey-chan, so I'd best stay here.
Ummm, the safe one!
Hmmm, ass-ault? De-fense? The yummy one!
Defeating those who would destroy the world is the Mitsurugi clan's duty. Assault or defense, I'm ready to do my best!
I made my name as a hard puncher, but my defense is good too.
I almost destroyed the world. I have no right to choose... I'll leave it to you.
I'm stickin' with Shinichi all the way! Assault team!
The defense team is decided.\n\nThe assault team members are gathering outside.
You can pick the defense team from the people here too. What do you want to do?
I think we'd better pick a leader for the assault team.
I think you'd be fine... {p}-kun, what do you think?
I see. You think ** would be good. Very well! Then the assault team leader is **! We're counting on you!
Yes!
Professor Yumi, the vanguard is ready! We're heading for the Hill of Beginnings now!
Good! Do your best, Koji-kun!
Good luck, Koji-kun!
Leave it to me!
Following the vanguard, the assault team moves out!
Everyone, be careful! Please... save {s}!
The defense team will wait at the hotel entrance. Professor, you all stay somewhere safe in the back.
Good. I'm counting on you.
If worst comes to worst, I'll protect {p}-kun, so don't worry.
Don't worry, you won't be needed, Honey.\n\nWe'll stop the enemy advance right here.
Thanks, Shusha-kun!
Should you wish to swap members between the defense and assault teams, come speak to me, my boy. Any friend waiting in Hell Villa may be swapped in at any time!
Yes, Great King Enma.
{p}-kun, let's go back to the back room together. We'll wait for reports there.
So this is the device generating the barrier around the castle...
If we destroy this device, we should be able to rescue the vanguard...!
All riiight, let's go!
Here they come... Let's do this!
The vanguard led by Mazinger Z has set out for the Hill of Beginnings! They've begun engaging the giant black fiends! Next, Hell Villa's transfer is complete!
...So it has begun at last!
The transfer to the Hill of Beginnings is done! Let's head outside and come face to face with the Demon King!
Hell Villa's transfer is complete!
So far, everything is going to plan!
Dammit! The castle's surrounded by a barrier!? Mazinger can't get near the castle! Do something, assault team!
Mazinger's fighting the giant black fiends. But it looks like it can't get near the castle...
The castle seems to be protected by some kind of barrier. But the rioters are inside the castle too, right? Maybe there's an entrance somewhere...
